product.name: PromiseBenefits

product.name: PromisePay
product.description: A payment-plan platform for utilities and public agencies that helps customers manage outstanding balances through flexible, interest-free repayment options.

product.name: PromiseVerified
product.description: An income and eligibility verification solution that uses secure data sources and AI-assisted document processing to produce faster, more accurate determinations for government and utility programs.

product.name: PromiseAudit
product.description: An AI-based oversight platform that monitors public programs, policies, contracts, and operational data to identify compliance risks, waste, fraud, and abuse.
